briefdescription.para: Discovers the MST topology, routes stream N to the N-th sink found, and clears the payload ID tables of all downstream branches.

detaileddescription.para: If sideband messaging fails or finds no sink, all streams stay unrouted and NumStreams is unchanged, so XMmiDp_AllocatePayloadStream() programs only the directly attached branch.
A stream whose PBN exceeds the available PBN its path reports is not routed, and neither is any stream after it, since streams map to sinks by index.
